en: Vintage multi‑view postcard with three grayscale images framed decoratively: left shows a cobbled path and canal with arches labeled 'Hinter der Graft'; center shows a hillside with two defensive towers labeled 'Schwarzer und weisser Thurm'; right shows a spired city gate labeled 'Katharinenthor'. The printer credit appears at the bottom. The reverse bears Hungarian 'LEVELEZŐ-LAP.' with address lines and a stamp box.
